column15: Rose Peak is an energetic, multi-genre fusion rock sextet formed in late 2023 at the University of Washington in Seattle. Known for combining 1970s classic rock sensibilities with modern jazz-fusion, funk, psychedelic rock, and blues, the band has quickly established a strong footprint in the Pacific Northwest local scene.

column15: Koi Baryon is a Seattle-based band featuring soul-influenced rock infused with weighty lyrics and a fractured folk spirit. Marked by sophisticated musicianship, Koi continues to test the boundaries between experimental rock and heartfelt singer songwriter. In the words of the esteemed early- century philosopher MacLeanacles, "Life can be defined in two essential phases--the time before, and the life after one has heard Koi Baryon."
